trends.name: Iran Conflict & Energy Markets
trends.summary: Escalating US-Iran military operations including bridge strikes and carrier deployments are driving oil price volatility and mortgage rate increases. Market confidence in Hormuz reopening has collapsed to 30% odds before June 1, signaling sustained energy supply concerns and inflationary pressures on both sides of the Fed's mandate.

trends.name: Stock Market Valuation at Record Highs
trends.summary: US household equity exposure has reached 25.63% of net worth—the highest since the 1940s, exceeding the Dot-Com Bubble peak and 1968 highs. This extreme concentration signals elevated systemic risk as markets price in aggressive expectations, with cracks widening across breadth indicators.

trends.name: Military Spending & War Economy Shift
trends.summary: Trump administration planning 2027 war economy with massive military budget increases and healthcare cuts, signaling sustained defense spending tailwinds. Pentagon leadership changes and carrier deployments reinforce expansion of military-industrial investment thesis.

trends.name: Tesla Delivery Miss & EV Sector Weakness
trends.summary: Tesla's stock posted its steepest 2026 decline on disappointing delivery report, with management actively sacrificing EV volume. The miss signals demand pressure in the critical EV sector and raises questions about growth trajectory amid economic headwinds.

trends.name: Fed Monitoring Inflation & Credit Risks
trends.summary: Fed's Williams signaled close monitoring of private credit developments amid market repricing, noting higher energy prices are hitting inflation and disposable incomes on both sides of the mandate. Fed maintaining accommodative bias while acknowledging increased uncertainty and risks.

trends.name: Earnings Season & Growth Revisions
trends.summary: S&P 500 EPS estimates rising sharply amid earnings season, but employment data shows zero net job growth, raising questions about earnings quality and sustainability. Microchip and Energy Fuels showing improving trends while broader market faces growth-employment disconnect.

trends.name: AI Investment & Microsoft Momentum
trends.summary: Microsoft executives touting strong Copilot sales traction despite AI sector anxiety weighing on broader tech stocks. AI adoption accelerating but investor sentiment remains cautious on valuation and near-term profitability amid competing narratives.

trends.name: Trade Tariffs & Pharmaceutical Costs
trends.summary: Trump administration implementing up to 100% tariffs on imported drugs with selective exemptions, reshaping pharmaceutical supply chains and costs. Policy uncertainty creating winners and losers across healthcare sector with potential inflationary spillovers.

trends.name: Consumer Discretionary Headwinds
trends.summary: Starbucks turnaround moves failing to support stock; Sam's Club and airlines hiking fees amid fuel cost pressures; housing affordability deteriorating with mortgage rates up five consecutive weeks. Consumer purchasing power compressed by inflation and rising service costs.

trends.name: Cryptocurrency Regulatory Progress
trends.summary: Coinbase cleared key regulatory hurdle in stablecoin business expansion, signaling progress toward mainstream crypto integration. Tokenized stocks also gaining traction in international markets with US adoption expected soon, reshaping fintech landscape.

trends.name: Housing Sector Stress & Interest Rates
trends.summary: Mortgage rates rising for fifth consecutive week following Iran conflict escalation; housing affordability at critical levels. Furniture and housing-linked stocks showing weakness (PLYD, Bassett) as higher borrowing costs suppress demand in cyclical sector.

trends.name: China Equity Fund Repricing & Asia Growth
trends.summary: Morgan Stanley China A-Share fund tender offer completed at lower valuation; Asia-Pacific markets rising on Easter trade and Hormuz reopening hopes. China growth narrative remains under pressure despite regional market recovery and earnings seasons kicking off.
